export interface AgentActionClient {
    discover(): Promise<readonly ActionView[]>;
    delegate?: AgentDelegation;
    memory?: AgentMemoryTools;
    offer?(offer: AgentActionOffer): Promise<{
        offer_id: string;
    }>;
    check?(reference: ExactActionReference, input: unknown): Promise<void>;
    direct?(view: ActionView): boolean;
    invoke(reference: ExactActionReference, input: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown>;
}

        field: string;
        question: string;
    }>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryCandidateCapability {
    propose(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        text: string;
        origin: string;
        tags?: string[];
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    list(scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"], owner: string): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry[]>;
    accept(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
        text?: string;
        origin?: string;
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    promote(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
        policy: string;
        version: number;
        origin?: string;
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    settleInto(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
        memory_id: string;
        by: {
            by: "person";
        } | {
            by: "policy";
            policy: string;
            version: number;
        };
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    discard(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    expire(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryCandidateEntry>;
    purge(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        candidate_id: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryCandidateEntry {

}

export interface AgentMemoryCapability {
    list(scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"], owner: string): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry[]>;
    write(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        text: string;
        origin: string;
        tags?: string[];
        meta?: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    update(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        memory_id: string;
        text: string;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    setMeta?(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        memory_id: string;
        meta: AgentMemoryMeta;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    pause?(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        memory_id: string;
        reason: string;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    resume?(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        memory_id: string;
    }): Promise<AgentMemoryEntry>;
    remove(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        memory_id: string;
    }): Promise<boolean>;
    recall(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        keywords?: string[];
        text?: string;
        kinds?: string[];
        limit?: number;
    }): Promise<Array<{
        entry: AgentMemoryEntry;
        score: number;
    }>>;
    candidates?: AgentMemoryCandidateCapability;
    screen?(text: string): Promise<{
        hold: boolean;
        reasons: string[];
        redacted: string;
    }>;
    previewScope?(scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"], owner: string): Promise<{
        count: number;
        fingerprint: string;
        memory_ids: string[];
    }>;
    clearScope?(input: {
        scope: AgentMemoryEntry["scope"];
        owner: string;
        fingerprint: string;
    }): Promise<string[]>;
}

export interface AgentMemoryEntry {
    memory_id: string;
    scope: "user" | "project" | "character";
    owner: string;
    text: string;
    origin: string;
    tags: string[];
    version: number;
    meta: AgentMemoryMeta;
    paused?: {
        reason: string;
        at_ms: number;
    };
    created_at_ms: number;
    updated_at_ms: number;
}

export interface AgentMemoryMeta {
    kind?: string;
    source?: string;
    basis?: "explicit" | "repeated" | "inferred";
    applies_when?: {
        plugins?: string[];
        object_kinds?: string[];
        goals?: string[];
        task?: string;
        from_ms?: number;
        until_ms?: number;
    };
    evidence?: Array<{
        kind: string;
        text?: string;
        ref?: string;
        at_ms?: number;
    }>;
    expires_at_ms?: number;
    approved_by?: {
        by: "person";
    } | {
        by: "policy";
        policy: string;
        version: number;
    };
    namespace?: string;
}

export type AgentReviewDocument = AgentTextReviewDocument | AgentCommandReviewDocument | AgentToolOperationReviewDocument | AgentMcpReviewDocument | AgentGitIndexReviewDocument | AgentGitIntegrationReviewDocument | AgentRewindReviewDocument;

export type AgentReviewKind = "text-edit" | "command" | "tool-operation" | "mcp" | "rewind" | "git-index" | "git-integration";

export interface AgentReviewQueueApi {
    list(projectId: string, status?: AgentReviewStatus): AgentReviewRequest[];
    get(reviewId: string): AgentReviewRequest | null;
    decide(input: AgentReviewDecisionInput): AgentReviewReceipt;
    receipt(reviewId: string): AgentReviewReceipt | null;
    observe(listener: (request: AgentReviewRequest) => void): () => void;
}

export interface AgentReviewReceipt {

    status: AgentReviewStatus;
    decided_by: string | null;
    decided_at: string | null;
    note: string | null;
    effect_settled: boolean;
    effect_error: string | null;
    effect_uncertain?: string;
    delivery_error?: string;

        actor_id: string;
        at: string;
        reason: string;
    };
    standing_rule?: {
        set_by: string;
        set_at: string;
    };
}

export interface AgentReviewRecoveryInput {

export interface AgentReviewRecoveryView {

export interface AgentReviewRequest {
    review_id: string;
    run: AgentRunRef | null;
    operation?: {
        operation_id: string;
        session_id: string;
        kind: "checkpoint-rewind";
        workspace_id?: never;
    } | {
        operation_id: string;
        workspace_id: string;
        kind: "git-index" | "git-worktree" | "git-integration" | "git-operation";
        session_id?: never;
    };
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    kind: AgentReviewKind;
    document: AgentReviewDocument;
    requested_at: string;
    expires_at: string | null;
}

export type AgentReviewStatus = "pending" | "approved" | "rejected" | "cancelled" | "expired";

export interface AgentRunView {
    step_board?: AgentStepBoard;
    step_board_error?: string;
    ref: AgentRunRef;
    phase: AgentRunPhase;
    frozen: AgentFrozenStart;
    turns: AgentTurnView[];
    activity: AgentToolActivity[];
    command_outputs?: AgentCommandOutputRef[];
    usage: AgentRunUsage;
    awaiting_input: readonly AgentPendingQuestion[];
    stop_reason?: string;
    memory_recalled?: AgentMemoryRecallFact;
    todo?: readonly AgentTodoItem[];
    started_at: string;
    ended_at: string | null;
}

export interface AgentRuntimeAdapter {
    diagnostics?(): AgentRuntimeDiagnostics;
    readonly recovery?: AgentRecoveryCapability;
    readonly schedule?: AgentScheduleCapability;
    readonly memory?: AgentMemoryCapability;
    readonly documents?: AgentDocumentCapability;
    readonly descriptor: AgentRuntimeDescriptor;
    health(): Promise<AgentRuntimeHealth>;
    createSession(input: AgentCreateSessionInput): Promise<AgentSessionRef>;
    readSession(session: AgentSessionRef): Promise<AgentSessionView>;
    readSessionStatus?(session: AgentSessionRef): Promise<{
        owner: AgentSessionView["owner"];
        status: AgentSessionStatus;
    }>;
    readonly projectWork?: AgentProjectWorkCapability;
    readonly messages?: AgentSessionMessagesCapability;
    readonly waits?: AgentWaitsCapability;
    readonly background?: AgentBackgroundCapability;
    start(request: AgentStartRequest, execution?: AgentStartExecution): Promise<AgentRunHandle>;
    read(run: AgentRunRef): Promise<AgentRunView>;
    observe(run: AgentRunRef, listener: (view: AgentRunView) => void): () => void;
    control(run: AgentRunRef, control: AgentRunControl): Promise<void>;
    readCommandOutput(session: AgentSessionRef, ref: AgentCommandOutputRef): Promise<AgentCommandOutput>;
    readonly checkpoints?: AgentCheckpointsCapability;
    readonly skills?: AgentSkillsCapability;
    readonly skillLibrary?: AgentSkillLibrary;
    readonly mcpLibrary?: AgentMcpLibrary;
    readonly mcp?: AgentMcpCapability;
    readonly subagents?: AgentSubagentsCapability;
    amendStepBoard?(run: AgentRunRef, amendment: AgentStepAmendment, expectedVersion: number, actorId: string): Promise<AgentStepBoard>;
}

export type AgentRuntimeCapability = (typeof AGENT_RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES)[number];

export type AgentRuntimeCapabilityMatrix = Record<AgentRuntimeCapability, AgentCapabilitySupport>;

export interface AgentRuntimeDescriptor {
    supports_action_tools?: boolean;
    supports_workspace_none?: boolean;
    supports_workspace_business?: boolean;
    runtime_id: string;
    display_name: string;
    provider_version: string;
    capabilities: AgentRuntimeCapabilityMatrix;
}

export interface AgentRuntimeDiagnostics {
    app: {
        app_id: string;
        app_version: string;
    };
    state: "starting" | "ready" | "failed" | "stopped";
    fingerprint: string;
    slots: Array<{
        slot: string;
        state: "ready" | "disabled" | "unavailable";
        implementation: string | null;
        version: string | null;
        why: string | null;
        fallback: boolean;
    }>;
    host: {
        requested: string[];
        effective: string[];
        not_present: Array<{
            capability: string;
            state: string;
        }>;
    };
    ledger_failures: Array<{
        kind: string;
        seq: number;
        code: string | null;
        detail: string | null;
    }>;
}

export interface AgentRuntimeHealth {
    ok: boolean;
    status: AgentRuntimeHealthStatus;
    message: string;
    action?: string;
}

export type AgentRuntimeHealthStatus = "ready" | "needs_setup" | "unavailable";

export interface AgentScheduleCapability {
    claim(): {
        survives_window_close: boolean;
        why: string;
    };
    enqueue(input: {
        key: string;
        session_id: string;
        kind: string;
        payload: Record<string, unknown>;
        due_at: string;
        max_attempts?: number;
    }): Promise<AgentScheduledTask>;
    cancel(key: string): Promise<AgentScheduledTask | null>;
    find(key: string): AgentScheduledTask | null;
    list(kind?: string): AgentScheduledTask[];
    handle(kind: string, run: (task: AgentScheduledTask) => Promise<void>): () => void;
}

export interface AgentScheduledTask {
    task_id: string;
    key: string;
    session_id: string;
    kind: string;
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    due_at: string;
    state: "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed" | "reconcile-required" | "cancelled";
    attempts: number;
    runs: number;
    last_failure?: string;
}

export interface AgentSessionMessage {
    message_id: string;
    from_session: string;
    to_session: string;
    from_title: string;
    to_title: string;
    kind: "request" | "notice" | "reply" | "handoff";
    body: string;
    state: "queued" | "delivered" | "accepted" | "rejected" | "completed" | "expired" | "cancelled";
    sent_at_ms: number;
    in_reply_to?: string;
    await_reply?: true;
    audience?: "people";
    attachments?: AgentMessageAttachment[];
    history?: Array<{
        event: string;
        state: AgentSessionMessage["state"];
        at_ms: number;
        by?: string;
        note?: string;
        attachments?: AgentMessageAttachment[];
        late?: true;
    }>;
    hops?: number;
}

export interface AgentSessionMessagesCapability {
    read(project: string, sessionId?: string): Promise<AgentSessionMessage[]>;
    cancel(project: string, messageId: string): Promise<void>;
    prioritize?(project: string, sessionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<{
        notified: string[];
        paths: string[];
    }>;
    sendForPeople?(project: string, input: AgentPeopleMessageInput, actorId: string): Promise<AgentSessionMessage>;
    act?(project: string, messageId: string, action: AgentPeopleMessageAction, detail: {
        event?: string;
        note?: string;
        attachments?: AgentMessageAttachment[];
    }, actorId: string): Promise<AgentSessionMessage>;
}

export interface AgentSessionRef {
    session_id: string;
    runtime_id: string;
}

export interface AgentSessionStatus {
    session_id: string;
    latest_phase: AgentRunPhase | null;
    recovery: boolean;
    checkpoint_busy: boolean;
    steps?: {
        mine: number;
        subtasks: number;
        unowned: number;
    };
}

export interface AgentSessionView {
    workspace?: "required" | "none" | "business";
    checkpoint_busy?: boolean;
    recovery?: {
        required: true;
        reason: string;
    };
    owner: Pick<AgentCreateSessionInput, "project_id" | "plugin_id" | "install_id" | "actor_id">;
    session: AgentSessionRef;
    title: string;
    runs: AgentRunRef[];
    latest_run: AgentRunView | null;
}

export interface AgentSkillCandidate {
    candidate_id: string;
    name: string;
    summary: string;
    source_label: string;
    files: string[];
    body: string;
}

export interface AgentSkillCatalogEntry extends AgentSkillDeclaration {
    source: "builtin" | "installed";
    enabled: boolean;
}

export interface AgentSkillLibrary {
    list(owner: AgentSkillOwner): Promise<AgentSkillCatalogEntry[]>;
    read(owner: AgentSkillOwner, ref: AgentSkillRef): Promise<AgentSkillDefinition>;
    discover(owner: AgentSkillOwner, directory: AgentWorkingDirectory, path: string): Promise<AgentSkillCandidate[]>;
    install(owner: AgentSkillOwner, candidateId: string): Promise<AgentSkillCatalogEntry>;
}

export interface AgentSkillOwner {
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
}

export interface AgentSkillRef {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;
}

export interface AgentSkillsCapability {
    catalog(session: AgentSessionRef): Promise<AgentSkillCatalogEntry[]>;
}

export interface AgentStartExecution {
    beforeStart?(): void | Promise<void>;
    beforeDispatch?(): void | Promise<void>;
}

export type AgentStartRequest = AgentStartRequestFields & AgentWorkspace;

export type AgentStepAmendment = {
    kind: "skip";
    node: string;
    reason: string;
} | {
    kind: "insert";
    after: string;
    title: string;
    acceptance: string;
    mine?: true;
} | {
    kind: "unblock";
    node: string;
    note: string;
} | {
    kind: "move";
    node: string;
    direction: "up" | "down";
} | {
    kind: "assign";
    node: string;
    to: "me" | "session";
} | {
    kind: "resolve";
    node: string;
    state: "succeeded" | "failed";
    note: string;
};

export interface AgentStepBoard {
    project_id: string;
    version: number;
    terminal: boolean;
    nodes: Array<{
        id: string;
        state: "not-started" | "ready" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "blocked";
        reports: Array<{
            note: string;
            at_ms: number;
            by?: string;
            handover?: true;
        }>;
        owner?: AgentStepOwner;
        title?: string;
        depends_on?: string[];
        inserted?: boolean;
    }>;
}

export interface AgentStepOwner {
    kind: "session" | "subtask" | "person" | "none" | "other";
    label: string;
    subagent_id?: string;
    actor_id?: string;
    expired?: true;
}

export type AgentSubagentState = "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "reconcile-required";

export interface AgentSubagentView {
    child_run?: AgentRunRef;
    activity?: AgentToolActivity[];
    usage?: AgentRunUsage;
    host_tools?: string[];
    error?: string;
    subagent_id: string;
    parent_run: AgentRunRef;
    role_id: string;
    role_name?: string;
    task: string;
    state: AgentSubagentState;
    result: string | null;
    workspace_path: string | null;
}

export interface AgentSubagentWorkspace {
    workspace_id: string;
    directory: AgentWorkingDirectory;
}

export interface AgentSubagentsCapability {
    workspaces?: true;
    list(run: AgentRunRef): Promise<AgentSubagentView[]>;
    cancel(run: AgentRunRef, subagentId: string, actorId: string): Promise<void>;
}

export interface AgentTextMaterial {
    material_id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    source_artifact_id: string;
    source_version: number;
}

export interface AgentTextReviewDocument {
    kind: "text-edit";
    workspace_path?: string;
    target_path: string;
    exists: boolean;
    before_text: string | null;
    after_text: string;
    concurrent?: string[];
}

export interface AgentTodoItem {
    id: string;
    text: string;
    state: "pending" | "in-progress" | "done" | "abandoned";
}

export interface AgentTokenCount {
    input: number;
    output: number;
    cached_input?: number;
    cache_creation?: number;
    reasoning?: number;
}

export interface AgentToolActivity {
    call_id: string;
    name: string;
    target: string;
    state: AgentToolActivityState;
    summary: string;
    output?: string;
    output_truncated?: boolean;
    output_hidden_lines?: number;
    at: string | null;
    sequence?: number;
}

export type AgentToolActivityState = "started" | "completed" | "failed" | "unknown";

export interface AgentToolOperationReviewDocument {
    kind: "tool-operation";
    tool: string;
    summary: string;
    fields: Array<{
        label: string;
        value: string;
    }>;
}

export type AgentTurnKind = "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "notice";

export interface AgentTurnView {
    turn_id: string;
    kind: AgentTurnKind;
    text: string;
    at: string | null;
    sequence?: number;
    steer?: {
        id: string;
        state: "received" | "applied" | "unconfirmed";
    };
}

export type AgentUsageCoverage = "unknown" | "reported" | "estimated" | "partial" | "partial-estimated";

export interface AgentWait {
    wait_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id?: string;
    by: "agent" | "app";
    state: "waiting" | "fired" | "resumed" | "cancelled" | "expired";
    reason: string;
    waiting_on: string;
    on: Array<{
        kind: "command";
        task: string;
        until: "exit" | "output";
        match?: string;
    } | {
        kind: "envelope";
        envelope: string;
    } | {
        kind: "board-node";
        board: string;
        node: string;
    }>;
    fired?: {
        kind: "command" | "envelope" | "board-node";
        target: string;
        outcome: "succeeded" | "failed" | "stopped" | "interrupted" | "output" | "answered" | "settled" | "withdrawn" | "done" | "not-done";
        text: string;
        at_ms: number;
        reply?: string;
    };
    data?: unknown;
    created_at_ms: number;
    expires_at_ms: number;
    closed_at_ms?: number;
    note?: string;
}

export interface AgentWaitsCapability {
    read(project: string, sessionId?: string): Promise<AgentWait[]>;
    awaitFired(project: string, timeoutMs: number, exclude?: string[], signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentWait[]>;
    resume(project: string, waitId: string, note?: string): Promise<AgentWait>;
    cancel(project: string, waitId: string, note?: string): Promise<AgentWait>;
}

export interface AgentWorkingDirectory {
    canonical_path: string;
    realpath_verified: boolean;
}

export type AgentWorkspace = {
    workspace?: "required";
    directory: AgentWorkingDirectory;
} | {
    workspace: "none";
    directory?: never;
} | {
    workspace: "business";
    directory?: never;
};

export interface BoundedInferenceReceipt {
    readonly run_ref: {
        readonly kind: "run";
        readonly id: string;
        readonly revision: number;
    };
    readonly state: "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "tripped" | "circuit-tripped";
    readonly configuredModel: string;
    readonly reportedModels: readonly string[];
    readonly usage: readonly {
        readonly input: InferenceTokenCount;
        readonly output: InferenceTokenCount;
        readonly cacheRead: InferenceTokenCount;
        readonly cacheWrite: InferenceTokenCount;
        readonly cost: {
            readonly source: InferenceUsageSource;
            readonly amount?: number;
            readonly currency?: string;
        };
    }[];
}

export interface BuilderAgentActivity {
    type: 'file' | 'check' | 'tool';
    name: string;
    detail: string;
    path?: string;
}

export interface BuilderAgentRecord {
    id: string;
    role: BuilderAgentRequest['role'] | 'model';
    promptVersion: string;
    contractRevision: string;
    instruction: string;
    input: string;
    output: string;
    configuredModel: string;
    reportedModels: string[];
    sessionId?: string;
    runId?: string;
    phase: 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'interrupted';
    startedAt: string;
    finishedAt?: string;
    error?: string;
    activity: BuilderAgentActivity[];
    usage: unknown[];
}

export interface BuilderAgentRequest {
    role: 'designer' | 'coder';
    instruction: string;
    promptVersion: string;
    skills?: readonly BuilderSkill[];
    task: string;
    contractRevision: string;
    images?: readonly {
        label: string;
        bytes: Uint8Array;
    }[];
    operationIds?: readonly string[];
    writable?: readonly string[];
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    checks?(operationIds: readonly string[], signal: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown>;
    onActivity?(activity: BuilderAgentActivity): void;
}

export interface BuilderSkill {
    id: string;
    version: number;
    name: string;
    body: string;
}

export interface InferenceTokenCount {
    readonly source: InferenceUsageSource;
    readonly tokens?: number;
}

export type InferenceUsageSource = "reported" | "estimated" | "unknown";

export declare const agentHostCapabilities: {
    readonly listActions: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string], readonly ActionView[]>;
    readonly listRuntimes: HostCapabilityDefinition<[], AgentRuntimeDescriptor[]>;
    readonly availableRoles: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string], Array<{
        role_id: string;
        available: boolean;
        reason?: string;
    }>>;
    readonly createSession: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: AgentCreateSessionInput], AgentSessionRef>;
    readonly listSubagents: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef], AgentSubagentView[]>;
    readonly cancelSubagent: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, subagentId: string, actorId: string], void>;
    readonly amendStepBoard: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, amendment: AgentStepAmendment, expectedVersion: number], AgentStepBoard>;
    readonly readSession: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef], AgentSessionView>;
    readonly readSessionStatuses: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionIds: string[]], Array<AgentSessionStatus | {
        session_id: string;
        error: string;
    }>>;
    readonly readProjectWork: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, probe?: {
        session_id?: string;
        directory: string;
        text: string;
    }], {
        items: AgentProjectWork[];
        overlaps: AgentProjectWorkOverlap[];
    }>;
    readonly readMessages: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId?: string], AgentSessionMessage[]>;
    readonly prioritizeSession: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId: string], {
        notified: string[];
        paths: string[];
    }>;
    readonly sendPeopleMessage: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: AgentPeopleMessageInput], AgentSessionMessage>;
    readonly actOnPeopleMessage: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, messageId: string, action: AgentPeopleMessageAction, detail?: {
        event?: string;
        note?: string;
        attachments?: AgentMessageAttachment[];
    }], AgentSessionMessage>;
    readonly cancelMessage: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, messageId: string], void>;
    readonly queueProjectRound: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, input: {
        session: AgentSessionRef;
        directory: string;
        task: string;
        after: string;
        title?: string;
        data?: unknown;
    }], AgentProjectWork>;
    readonly readWaits: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId?: string], AgentWait[]>;
    readonly awaitFiredWaits: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, timeoutMs: number, exclude?: string[]], AgentWait[]>;
    readonly resumeWait: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, waitId: string, note?: string], AgentWait>;
    readonly cancelWait: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, waitId: string, note?: string], AgentWait>;
    readonly readBackground: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, sessionId?: string], AgentBackgroundTask[]>;
    readonly stopBackground: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, taskId: string], boolean>;
    readonly releaseProjectRound: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, workId: string, note: string], void>;
    readonly listSkills: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string], AgentSkillCatalogEntry[]>;
    readonly readSkill: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string, ref: AgentSkillRef], AgentSkillDefinition>;
    readonly discoverSkills: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string, directory: AgentWorkingDirectory, path: string], AgentSkillCandidate[]>;
    readonly installSkill: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string, candidateId: string], AgentSkillCatalogEntry>;
    readonly listMcp: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string], AgentMcpServerView[]>;
    readonly saveMcp: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string, input: AgentMcpServerInput], AgentMcpServerView>;
    readonly controlMcp: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, pluginId: string, id: string, action: "connect" | "disconnect" | "cancel" | "remove"], void>;
    readonly startRun: HostCapabilityDefinition<[runtimeId: string, request: AgentStartRequest], AgentRunHandle>;
    readonly readRun: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef], AgentRunView>;
    readonly draftText: HostCapabilityDefinition<AgentDraftTextRequest, AgentDraftTextResult>;
    readonly waitRun: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, since: string | null, timeoutMs: number], {
        version: string;
        view: AgentRunView;
    }>;
    readonly controlRun: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, control: AgentRunControl], void>;
    readonly readCommandOutput: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, ref: AgentCommandOutputRef], AgentCommandOutput>;
    readonly inspectRecovery: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef], AgentRecoveryReport>;
    readonly recoverRun: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef, expectedVersion: number], AgentRecoveryReport>;
    readonly listCheckpoints: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef], AgentCheckpoint[]>;
    readonly prepareRewind: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, checkpointId: string, roleId: string], AgentReviewRequest>;
    readonly readRunReviews: HostCapabilityDefinition<[session: AgentSessionRef, run: AgentRunRef], Array<{
        request: AgentReviewRequest;
        receipt: AgentReviewReceipt | null;
    }>>;
    readonly listReviews: HostCapabilityDefinition<[projectId: string, status?: AgentReviewStatus], AgentReviewRequest[]>;
};

interface AgentCreateSessionFields {
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    install_id: string;
    actor_id: string;
    title: string;
}

interface AgentFrozenStartFields {
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[];
    action_gateway?: true;
    character_skill_ids?: string[];
    execution_plan?: AgentExecutionPlan;
    continues_step_board_of?: string;
    subagent_workspaces?: AgentSubagentWorkspace[];
    character?: AgentFrozenCharacter;
    role_id: string;
    role_version: number;
    execution: AgentRoleExecution;
    model_id: string;
    compaction?: {
        prompt_id: string;
        version: number;
        above_tokens: number;
    };
    model_context?: {
        window_tokens: number;
        prompt_includes_cache: boolean;
    };
    history?: "digest";
    thinking?: "adaptive";
    prompts: Array<{
        prompt_id: string;
        version: number;
        layer: AgentPromptLayer;
        user_revision?: number;
    }>;
    skills: AgentSkillDeclaration[];
    mcp_tools: AgentMcpToolRef[];
    mcp_sources?: AgentMcpSourceRef[];
    host_tools: string[];
    text_materials: Array<{
        material_id: string;
        title?: string;
        source_artifact_id: string;
        source_version: number;
    }>;
    image_materials?: Array<{
        material_id: string;
        title: string;
        media_type: string;
    }>;
    budget: AgentRunBudget | null;
}

interface AgentStartRequestFields {
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[];
    action_gateway?: boolean;
    character_skill_ids?: string[];
    execution_plan?: AgentExecutionPlan;
    continue_step_board_of?: string;
    queued_work_id?: string;
    session_title?: string;
    browser?: false;
    history?: "session" | "digest";
    subagent_workspaces?: AgentSubagentWorkspace[];
    character?: ArtifactReference | null;
    session: AgentSessionRef;
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    install_id: string;
    actor_id: string;
    task: string;
    role_id: string;
    model_selection?: {
        provider_id: string;
        model_id: string;
    };
    role?: AgentFrozenRole;
    text_materials?: AgentTextMaterial[];
    image_materials?: AgentImageMaterial[];
    skills?: AgentSkillRef[];
    mcp_tools?: AgentMcpToolRef[];
    mcp_sources?: AgentMcpSourceRef[];
    budget?: AgentRunBudget;
}
